## Overview

Quarto is a useful and versatile tool for combining your code, its results, and
your notes. Quarto documents are fully reproducible and support dozens of output
formats — PDFs, Word files, presentations, and more. You can even build your own
homepage with Quarto (this site is one!). This session goes through the basics to
get you started.

## Prerequisites

You are welcome to just come and listen. If you'd like to generate some reports
during the session, please install:

- the [Quarto command-line interface](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/)
- [Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/download)
